full_prompt_en: A square, flat-color illustration shows a lone person in a small rowboat on a still harbor at sunset. The dark boat sits slightly left of center in the lower half, facing toward the distant light. A seated figure in a brimmed hat is seen from behind, reduced to a compact near-black silhouette. Two narrow oars extend outward, one to either side, and the boat's reflection drops into the teal water beneath it. The harbor water occupies most of the picture, built from broad muted green-blue planes interrupted by thin dark horizontal ripples. A large orange-red sun hangs low near the center of the horizon. Its reflection reaches forward in broken coral-colored strips, threading through the otherwise cool water. On the left, blocky industrial buildings, piers, and the dark hulls of moored vessels form a dense silhouette. On the right, several quieter boats and tall thin masts line the bank, their reflections lightly repeated below. Pale cream cloud shapes surround the sun, and tiny birds mark the open upper sky. The perspective narrows toward the bright horizon between the two harbor banks. Edges are clean, angular, and simplified, with only a little printed texture across the larger color areas. The sunset is the main light source, flattening distant forms into dark silhouettes while making the orange stripes on water glow. The wide open center and small solitary foreground shape give the harbor a calm, reflective mood despite its working structures.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形平涂色彩插画呈现日落港湾里小船上的独自一人。深色小船位于下半幅中央偏左，朝向远处亮光。戴檐帽的坐姿人影背向观者，被概括成紧凑的近黑剪影。两支细桨向两侧伸出，船的倒影落入下方青绿色水面。港水占画面大部分，由宽阔低饱和绿蓝色平面组成，其间被纤细深色水平涟漪打断。一轮大橘红太阳低悬在中央附近的地平线上。它的倒影以断续珊瑚色细带向前伸来，穿过冷色水面。左侧块状工业建筑、码头和停泊船只的深色船体形成密集剪影。右侧几艘更安静的船和高细桅杆沿岸排开，倒影在下方轻轻重复。浅奶油色云形围住太阳，极小飞鸟点在上部开阔天空。透视在两侧港岸之间收向明亮地平线。边缘干净、棱角分明、形体简化，大片色域上仅有少量印刷颗粒。日落是主要光源，把远处形体压成深色剪影，又让水面橘色条纹发亮。宽敞空旷的中央和前景孤独的小形体，让这个有工作设施的港湾仍保持平静、沉思的情绪。
style_prompt_en: A graphic flat-color illustration arranges large muted teal and green-blue planes around a compact orange focal disk. Near-black silhouettes collect along the sides and in one small foreground accent, leaving a clear open channel through the middle. Long, thin horizontal marks break the cool lower field; a chain of warm coral stripes travels toward the viewer and sets the visual rhythm. Angular blocks and hairline verticals create a layered distant edge without intricate detail. Pale cream patches soften the upper space, while subtle printed grain prevents the flat fills from feeling mechanical. Backlighting simplifies distant forms and intensifies the contrast between dark cutout edges and warm glow. The composition is quiet and balanced, with spare marks, broad color areas, and a low horizon creating depth through overlap and reflection.
style_prompt_zh: 平涂图形插画围绕紧凑的橘色焦点圆盘组织大片低饱和青绿与绿蓝色平面。近黑剪影聚在两侧，并在前景形成一处小重音，把中央留成清楚的开阔通道。细长水平笔形切开下部冷色域；一串暖珊瑚色条纹向观者延伸，建立视觉节奏。棱角块面与发丝般竖线构成层叠的远方边界，而无需繁复细节。浅奶油色块柔化上部空间，淡淡印刷颗粒让平面填色不显机械。逆光简化远处形体，并增强深色剪纸边缘与暖光之间的反差。构图安静平衡，以稀疏笔痕、宽大色域和低地平线，通过遮叠与倒映建立深度。
theme_en: A lone rower in a harbor at orange sunset
theme_zh: 橘色日落港湾中的独自划船者
name: Emiliano Ponzi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
